title: Bubble Model - TB lesions in rhesus macaques: code and data
description:
Code and data of the paper Assessment of protective mechanisms in the evolution of Mycobacterium tuberculosis infection in rhesus macaques using a parameterized computational model (F. Muñoz, M. Català, I. Nogueira, B. Eguzkitza, S. Sharpe, C. Prats, P.-J. Cardona; Scientific Reports, 2026).

The Bubble Model simulates the growth, merging and spread of tuberculosis lesions in a virtual macaque lung. The repository contains the experimental data and the script that turns them into the model's targets, the virtual macaque lung, the model source code (C, MPI + OpenMP), the configuration and launcher of every simulation run of the paper (fits, experiments, sweeps, PRCC), and the scripts that collect the results and draw every figure.
